name: Sloterparkbad, President Allendelaan 3
surveyedSource: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012084387 ring (RD, PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) in native east/south metres above the 3DBAG ground (scripts/landmarks/sloterparkbad-footprints.json, written by pool-site-prepare.ts, with the OSM basin outline a488807746, ODbL). The shell is the 3DBAG LoD2.2 (CC BY 4.0); the north-west fronts are read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0: TMX7316010203-002508_pano_0004_000065, _000111, _000107, _000100); the roofs, solar field and basin deck from the PDOK luchtfoto (Beeldmateriaal Nederland, CC BY 4.0). Per item in scripts/landmarks/sloterparkbad-inventory.json.

attribution.title: Sloterparkbad, President Allendelaan 3: swimming and sports centre of 2001 on the Sloterplas
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) and the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0): the red-brick north-west front with its rows of square windows, glazed ground floor, ramped walkway with perforated balustrades and steel stair; the zinc west wing with its orange BASIC FIT bands; the solar field on the wing roof; the outdoor basin with its lanes and deck. Basin outline from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) checked on the PDOK luchtfoto (CC BY 4.0); fronts read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
